0.original: A happy ray is a productive ray, as Zukin well knows.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

25.original: Feed the striped ray at krill swarms by using its Inhale ability.

48.original: Fancy going for a little swim, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? If you have a moment to spare, Makura could use your help with the rays. They look after us, and so we must look after them.

49.original: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I've been waiting for you. I need you to take one of our rays out for a good feed─a reward for all of its toils.

50.original: Now, the fellow loves few things more than krill, and you'll find swarms of them close by. Please have him feed till he's had his fill.

51.original: Should you become separated from the ray, worry not─he is trained to return here. Happy feeding, then, and let Zukin know when you're done!

52.original: The ray sucks in a copious amount of seawater and krill.

53.original: The ray sucks in a copious amount of seawater and krill.

54.original: The ray sucks in a copious amount of seawater and krill.

55.original: There you are! The ray returned without you, and he's been champing at the bit to get back to his krill.

56.original: There is a large swarm of krill. You make a mental note of the spot for feeding the ray.

57.original: Welcome back, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I understand you treated the ray to a veritable banquet. This will doubtless do wonders for its spirit.

58.original: Makura tells me the creature is very fond of you, and who could blame it? When next it needs a good feed, I trust we can rely on you again.

59.original: Our little ray returned with a belly full of krill and a grin from gill to gill! Thank you so much, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!
